summary_rationale: PDS Limited operates a genuinely differentiated, asset-light global apparel sourcing and fashion infrastructure platform (₹13,110 Cr FY26 revenue; ₹4,432 Cr record Q2 FY27 revenue) with strong cash conversion (FY26 CFO ₹781 Cr; -5 days net working capital in Sep 2026) and a growing US retail footprint (+44% YoY in H1 FY27). However, consolidated operating margins remain thin (3.1% in FY26; 3.5% in Q2 FY27), 3-year ROE has compressed to ~6.5%-9.8% due to P&L growth investments and losses at the Ted Baker (New Lobster) brand management unit (under review after an ₹11 Cr H1 FY27 loss), and negative working capital relies partly on receivable factoring and extended payables. Business quality is therefore conditionally attractive—dependent on sustaining operating leverage, resolving Ted Baker, and converting Americas account openings into durable >2.5%-3.0% PAT margins.
